categories.name: Protein Powders
categories.description: Compare isolate, concentrate, hydrolysate, and casein on protein per scoop, purity, lactose, sugars, and cost efficiency.

categories.name: Plant Protein
categories.description: Plant powders scored on protein density, completeness proxies, sodium (common issue), fillers, and allergen profile.

categories.name: Creatine
categories.description: Creatine is about dose honesty and purity — 3–5g monohydrate, minimal fillers, no sugar-loaded “delivery” blends unless you want them.

categories.name: Mass Gainers
categories.description: Gainers trade purity for calories. We score protein density, added sugar, allergen load, and whether it fits a bulking vs cutting goal.

categories.name: BCAA / Aminos
categories.description: Amino products scored on active amino grams, filler ratio, artificial sweeteners, and cost per gram of actives.

categories.name: Collagen
categories.description: Collagen isn’t a complete muscle protein — we score peptide dose, fillers/flavors, sugars, and transparency.

categories.name: Pre-Workout
categories.description: Pre-workouts scored on disclosed actives (citrulline, caffeine), proprietary-blend opacity, sugar, and stim transparency.

categories.name: Omega-3
categories.description: Omega-3s scored on EPA+DHA per serving, oxidation risk proxies, fillers, and cost per gram of combined EPA/DHA.

categories.name: Multivitamins
categories.description: Multis are hard to score perfectly — we focus on unnecessary sugar, artificials, allergen fillers, and transparency of doses.
